_comment: The response and planning template, as data. Edit this file (or use scripts/agent-template.mjs), then run `npm run template:render`. Everything human-readable is generated from here.

required.label: TASK
required.desc: Restate the task in one plain sentence, in the user's words.
required.example: Add rate limiting to the upload endpoint.

required.label: DONE WHEN
required.desc: The observable thing that will be true, and how it gets checked.
required.example: Uploads over 10/min return 429 · checked by: npm run test:upload

required.label: ALREADY?
required.desc: Whether this was built before: new | partly done | already exists | tried and stopped.
required.example: partly done — middleware/rateLimit.ts exists, not wired to uploads

required.label: FILES
required.desc: Exact paths to create, edit or delete.

required.label: PLAN
required.desc: Numbered steps with the commands that prove each one.
required.example: 1. Wire limiter  2. Add 429 test  3. npm run test:upload

required.label: NET
required.desc: Lines added vs removed. Adding only? Say what was considered for removal.

optional.label: BETTER IDEA
optional.when: a simpler route exists than the one asked for
optional.desc: The simpler route and why it might win.

optional.label: TOOLS
optional.when: an existing library or tool would do this job
optional.desc: 2–3 GitHub projects, what each gives THIS task, marked unverified if unchecked.

optional.label: DOCS
optional.when: a document, spec, audit or design file matters here
optional.desc: Files to read, each marked current / outdated / prototype / demo, and what it does not prove.

optional.label: BRANCHES
optional.when: branches or PRs relate to this task
optional.desc: Related branches and closed PRs with dates — what was tried before.

optional.label: REDUCE
optional.when: duplicates, unused code or near-copies were found
optional.desc: What can be merged, quarantined or deleted instead of added to.

optional.label: RISK
optional.when: a real blocker was verified
optional.desc: The blocker and the command that proved it.

optional.label: PROTOTYPE
optional.when: seeing it beats reading about it
optional.desc: A small standalone HTML file or demo worth building first, and what it should leave out.

optional.label: OWNER
optional.when: it is unclear which part of the codebase owns these files
optional.desc: Who or what owns each path, so two changes do not collide.

optional.label: TESTS
optional.when: the changed files have tests, or conspicuously do not
optional.desc: Which tests cover this, or that none do.

optional.label: ROLLBACK
optional.when: the change is hard to undo
optional.desc: How to reverse it.

optional.label: COST
optional.when: the work is large or open-ended
optional.desc: Rough effort and where it might overrun.

optional.label: SKILL
optional.when: the same guidance has come up three times
optional.desc: A reusable skill, rule or command worth saving.

optional.label: TASK
optional.when: this maps to a tracked task id
optional.desc: The task id, and the status being proposed with its evidence.

optional.label: SAVED
optional.when: files, docs or screenshots were produced
optional.desc: Where they were saved.

optional.label: RETIRE
optional.when: something outdated, duplicated or wrong was noticed
optional.desc: One thing worth deleting, merging or correcting.

optional.label: UNFINISHED
optional.when: work remains
optional.desc: What is left and what would unblock it.

required.label: Goal
required.desc: One sentence: what this task achieves.

required.label: Done when
required.desc: The observable result and the command that checks it.

required.label: Before → After
required.desc: Real evidence: behaviour, line counts, screenshots.

required.label: Status
required.desc: in progress | finished | blocked | abandoned, plus branch and date.

optional.label: Prior work
optional.when: earlier attempts exist
optional.desc: Branches, PRs and files from previous attempts.

optional.label: References
optional.when: documents inform the work
optional.desc: Docs, audits, designs — with what each does not prove.

optional.label: Decisions
optional.when: a choice was made between options
optional.desc: What was chosen and why the alternative lost.

optional.label: Risks
optional.when: something could go wrong
optional.desc: What might break and the early warning sign.

optional.label: Reduction
optional.when: code was removed, merged or quarantined
optional.desc: What went, where it went, and how to restore it.

optional.label: Follow-ups
optional.when: work is deliberately deferred
optional.desc: What was left out on purpose.

rules: A section appears only if it changes what the user does next. No empty headings, no 'N/A', no padding.
Required sections always appear. Optional sections appear when their 'when' is true.
Prefer removing code to adding it. Use the shared or default component before building a new one.
Quarantine before deleting. Record where it came from and how to restore it.
Separate what you ran and observed from what you believe but did not run.
Link to files; do not paste them into the conversation.
A prototype or demo proves nothing about what actually runs.
